description: Negative: truncation is invisible to link checking. The single line present hashes correctly and its prev is the 64-zero genesis of AGSC-08-22, so a verifier that only walks the chain reports success — yet the published agsc-ledger-head on the rel#ledger link is the hash of the trailing build entry (AGSC-08-20a) that has been cut away. AGSC-08-23 therefore also requires the recomputed head to equal the published head; the mismatch is AGSC-E701.
